verdict.rationale: monday.com's docs reference an 'updates' and @mention system used to communicate on items (e.g., 'Message them in updates... @mention them in any conversation'), implying built-in commenting/collaboration threads tied to work items, but the evidence pack frames this almost entirely around AI agent messaging rather than explicit team-to-team chat. No dedicated real-time chat feature is described, and community feedback criticizes the UI as slow/clunky for collaborative use.
